lead_raw_text:
The structure of Tm4Cu2Ag4 (reduced formula Tm2CuAg2) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 10 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis using CrystalNN shows Ag, Cu, and Tm centers each with 12 geometric neighbors in close-packed-like local arrangements, with neighbor distances of 2.9055–3.05 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 10 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies 12-vertex Ag and Tm coordination polyhedra connected through corner-, edge-, and face-sharing contacts.
